name: The Thandol Span
summary: On the Thandol Span, a murder puts Ironforge’s northern road at risk. Ebenezer Rustlocke is dead, and Rhag Garmason has found explosives hidden by Kam Deepfury.

sections.title: A Plot Revealed
sections.body: A recovered document lays bare the crime beneath the Thandol Span. Ebenezer Rustlocke was murdered in the bridge’s substructure. The papers reveal more: Kam Deepfury, the Dark Iron agitator who first destroyed part of the bridge, has not stopped. His network planted another cache of heavy munitions just across the northern border in the Arathi Highlands, ready to finish the destruction.

sections.title: Saving the Lifeline
sections.body: The Span links Khaz Modan and Stormwind to the war-torn lands in the north. Rhag Garmason orders an immediate strike against the sabotage cache in Arathi, before Deepfury’s conspirators can use it. Destroying the munitions ends the immediate danger and keeps Ironforge’s road north open. Yet Garmason still has too few troops to defend the gap.

faq.answer: Kam Deepfury is the Dark Iron dwarf mastermind behind the Thandol Span sabotage. After collapsing the first arch, he hid more explosives across the chasm in the Arathi Highlands to destroy the rest of the bridge.

faq.q: Why is the Thandol Span so strategically vital?
faq.answer: The Span is the only land bridge across the immense chasm between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. If it falls, the Alliance loses its main overland supply route between Ironforge, Stormwind, and its allies holding ground in northern Lordaeron.
Ebenezer Rustlocke was an Ironforge defender murdered beneath the bridge. His investigation and recovered papers led Rhag Garmason to uncover Deepfury’s hidden explosive cache.

faq.q: Where is the cache of explosives hidden?
faq.answer: The explosives were hidden just across the Span, on the Arathi Highlands side. Deepfury’s conspirators could carry them quickly to the surviving bridge structure.

faq.q: Who gives the order to destroy the explosives?
faq.answer: Rhag Garmason, a dwarf officer stationed on the Wetlands side of the Thandol Span, orders the cache found and demolished. He means to honor Rustlocke’s sacrifice and protect the remaining bridge.

faq.q: What happens after the munitions are destroyed?
faq.answer: With the munitions destroyed, the immediate sabotage threat is over. Rhag Garmason knows his garrison cannot hold the damaged bridge indefinitely without help. While he waits for Ironforge’s reserves, he sends a plea for reinforcements to Captain Nials at the Alliance camp in Refuge Pointe, in the Arathi Highlands.

angles.text: For the sons of Ironforge, defending the Thandol Span protects King Magni’s lifeline to northern allies. It also strikes a blow against Dark Iron infiltrators who have betrayed their kin.
Holding the Span is vital to the continent’s safety. If the crossing falls, moving Alliance armies and supplies into Arathi and Lordaeron becomes far more dangerous.
As an engineer, you can see the destructive power of Deepfury’s munitions cache. It was built to demolish colossal dwarven stonework made in the style of the titans.
